description: TPO 189 T16 1x Common Walnut to crown lift to approx 2m and reduce lateral overhang back from the fire doors by 0.5m. T13 1x Sliver Maple to fell and replace.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The removal of deadwood, dangerous / hanging branches and ivy:  This does not require the formal consent of the Council.

Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981:  Note that it is an offence under this act to disturb roosting bats, nesting birds or any other protected species.  Therefore, if applicable, it is advisable to consult your tree surgeon / consultant to agree an acceptable time for carrying out the approved works.

The trees to be pruned shall be crown lifted as per the approved specification. This work shall involve the tip reduction of low hanging branches and/or the removal of low branches to the height specified and result in a tree of balanced appearance; those branches to be removed shall be removed at their origin and all branch collars shall be left intact.

The works shall be carried out in accordance with the recommendations contained in BS 3998:2010 'Tree work - Recommendations'. Climbing irons or 'spikes' shall not be used during the execution of this work.
In order to protect health of the tree and the visual amenity of the area.
TPO 189 T16 1x Common Walnut to crown lift to approx 2m and reduce lateral overhang back from the fire doors by 0.5m.
TPO 189 T13 1x Sliver Maple to fell and replace.

The trees are located on the grounds of the property and can be seen by neighbours and passers. They are in a fair to good condition and are early mature to mature. For these reasons these trees have a high amenity value.

The felling and replacement of the Silver Maple removes the amenity and the replacement will take a number of years to provide the same amenity. There has been no evidence provided to suggest that the tree is a risk, apart from its location.
The Silver Maple specification is not accepted.
